keyInsights.title: Record Turnover Rs.6.03B — But Breadth Only 151/105
keyInsights.body: May 27 set another turnover record at Rs.6,030,064,840.96, yet market breadth was weak at 151 advances vs 105 declines. This divergence between high turnover and poor breadth — combined with B58 being the largest net seller in the series (-Rs.89.1M) — suggests institutional distribution into retail-driven volume.

keyInsights.body: Broker 58 sold Rs.529.7M vs bought Rs.440.6M, a net sell of Rs.89.1M — the highest single-day net sell in this tracked series. The most alarming signal: AKJCL net sold 193,602 kitta (largest absolute net sell ever recorded) and CITY pure sold 78,881 kitta at 48.60% share. B58 is clearly in heavy distribution mode.

This is a classic 'distribution into strength' pattern. When the largest broker is offloading at this scale into a price rally, caution is warranted for AKJCL longs.

summary: NEPSE marginally gained +4.99 points (+0.17%) on May 27, 2026 to close at 2782.10 on record Rs.6.03B turnover. However, the session had serious underlying distribution signals: breadth was only 151/105, 5 of 13 sub-indices were red, and Broker 58 posted its largest net sell in the tracked series at -Rs.89.1M. The standout alert is API — now effectively AT its 52W high of 364.20 (LTP 364.00) with RSI 68.94, ADX 28.98, and MACD histogram +3.43. NHPC saw massive B58 re-accumulation (+103,091 net kitta). NABIL maintains the strongest banking setup. Critical warnings: AKJCL distribution (193,602 net kitta sold), CITY sustained selling (78,881 kitta at 48.60%), SAIL MACD histogram -27.61, and ULHC ADX 45.27 downtrend.
